plotSections.title: The spectral door is not real
bullets: With guidance, Gerk’s investigation total of 18 reveals the floating spectral door is fake protective magic with no portal or opening capability.
Gerk, Sylan, and Ord all find their hands pass through it into slightly thicker air without physical effect.
Gerk wildly swings through the door without changing it.
The DM confirms passing through the spectral door would not simply restore sight or hearing.

plotSections.title: Planning dispel magic
bullets: Sylan says dispel magic may be the party’s best available tool but warns about their poor track record with it.
The party fears dispelling the wrong effect could drop the ship; Dana is the one most likely able to prevent a fatal fall.
Ord proposes zone of truth as a meme workaround, but the group moves toward dispel magic instead.
Ord declares he will cast dispel magic only on the spectral door and explicitly not on the boat or its wings.
The party recalls a past dispel during the Sunder Chase that went badly.

plotSections.title: Can Gerk replace the fake door?
bullets: Ord asks whether Gerk, as Doorman, can create a real door in place of the fake spectral one.
Sylan says he already tried to get Gerk to interact with it without success.
Gerk refuses to listen to Ord and suggests they could simply leave through a new magic door instead.
The chunk ends with the DM asking whether Gerk will open a door.
